onlyMainContent.note: Boolean; drops headers, navs and footers before markdown is generated.

onlyCleanContent.note: Boolean; an extra LLM pass over the markdown to remove leftover boilerplate.

includeTags.note: List of tags or selectors to keep.

excludeTags.note: List of tags or selectors to drop.

maxAge.note: Milliseconds; serves a cached copy younger than this.

minAge.note: Milliseconds; checks the cache only and never scrapes afresh.

headers.note: Headers Firecrawl sends to the target page, such as cookies or a user agent.

waitFor.note: Milliseconds to wait before reading the page.

timeout.note: Milliseconds, 1000-300000; Firecrawl's own limit, separate from the HTTP client's.

parsers.note: How PDFs and images are processed.

actions.note: Browser actions (click, scroll, wait, ...) run before the page is read.

location.note: Country and languages; picks a proxy and emulates the locale.

blockAds.note: Boolean; blocks ads and cookie pop-ups.

storeInCache.note: Boolean; false keeps the page out of Firecrawl's index and cache.

lockdown.note: Boolean; serves from cache only, with no request to the target.

checkPromptInjection.note: Boolean; scans the page before any LLM-backed format runs.

redactPII.note: true or an object; redacts personal data from the markdown.

profile.note: Persistent browser storage shared across scrapes.

threatProtection.note: Per-request override of the account's threat protection settings.

auditMetadata.note: User attribution attached to SIEM log events.

zeroDataRetention.note: Boolean; no data kept for this scrape.

alexandria.note: Runs catalogued provider tools instead of a scrape and cannot be combined with url or formats, which web-router always sends.

domainTools.note: Boolean; lists tool contracts for the page's domain in data.tools, which stays in raw.

toolDetail.note: compact | summary | full; only with domainTools.
